thesis: The episode introduces Michael Batnick, a researcher at Ritholtz Wealth Management and author of 'Big Mistakes,' who discusses his unconventional career path from academic dismissal to financial research. The conversation begins by exploring Batnick's early life struggles, including poor grades and dropping out of Indiana University, followed by his humiliating experience selling unwanted whole life insurance policies before he began self-studying market research.
